attributes.name: Dogfinder
attributes.powers:
Put this card on top of another character's deck to add 1d4 to your Wisdom check.

If you have the Goblin trait, banish this card to draw 1d4+1 random cards from your discard pile.

"Zarongel says this toad's no good
So Poog stomped it, like he should.''"

corrections.corrected_text: On the item Dogfinder, change "shuffle 1d4+1 cards from your discard pile into your hand" to "draw 1d4+1 random cards from your discard pile."
corrections.issue: Dogfinder tells you to shuffle cards into your hand. Is it meant to be shuffled into your deck, or drawn into your hand?
